passages.text: (UNLESS INDICATED OTHERWISE, DOLLARS IN MILLIONS EXCEPT PER SHARE AMOUNTS) OVERVIEW Company Background In 2025, we were organized into five reportable operating segments: Taste, Food Ingredients, Health & Biosciences, Scent and, until its divestiture in May 2025, Pharma Solutions. Our Taste segment consists of the development and production of a range of flavor compounds and natural taste solutions that are ultimately used by our customers in a diverse variety of products, including savory products (soups, sauces, meat, fish, poultry, snacks, etc.), beverages (juice drinks, carbonated or flavored beverages, spirits, etc.), sweets (bakery products, candy, cereal, chewing gum, etc.), and dairy products (yogurt, ice cream, cheese, etc.). Taste also includes value-added spices and seasoning ingredients for meat, food service, convenience, alternative protein and culinary products. Our Food Ingredients segment consists of a diversified portfolio across natural, artificial and plant-based specialty food ingredients that provide functional properties solutions for food and beverage products, as well as specialty soy and pea protein with value-added formulations, emulsifiers and sweeteners. Natural food protection ingredients consist of natural antioxidants and anti-microbials used for natural food preservation and shelf-life extension for beverages, cosmetic and healthcare products, pet food and feed additives. Food Ingredients also includes savory solutions (such as spices, marinades, and mixtures) and inclusion products (such as products combining flavorings with fruit, vegetables and other natural ingredients). 24 Table of Contents Our Health & Biosciences segment consists of the development and production of an advanced biotechnology-derived portfolio of enzymes, food cultures, probiotics and specialty ingredients for food and non-food applications. Among many other applications, our portfolio includes cultures for use in fermented foods such as yogurt, cheese and fermented beverages, probiotic strains, household detergents, animal feed, ethanol production and brewing. Health & Biosciences is comprised of Health, Food Biosciences, Home & Personal Care, Animal Nutrition and Grain Processing. Our Scent segment creates fragrance compounds and fragrance ingredients that are integral elements in the world’s finest perfumes and best-known household and personal care products. Consumer insights, science and creativity are at the heart of our Scent business, along with our unique portfolio of natural and synthetic ingredients, global footprint, innovative technologies and know-how, and customer intimacy. The Scent segment is comprised of Fragrance Compounds and Fragrance Ingredients. Our former Pharma Solutions segment produced, among other things, a vast portfolio of cellulosics and seaweed-based pharmaceutical excipients, used in prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceuticals and dietary supplements. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: We routinely encounter and address risks in conducting our business. Some of these risks may cause our future results to be different - sometimes materially different – than in the past or than we presently anticipate. Below are some of the risks we have identified that could adversely affect our business. How we react to material future developments, as well as how our competitors and customers react to those developments, could also affect our future results. Risks Related to Our Business and Industry Consumer demand and preferences, as well as regulatory trends may impact demand for our products, which may have a negative effect on our operating results and future growth. Many of our products are ingredients or components in consumer products which are sold to end-users throughout the world. Demand for such consumer products depends on consumer preferences that are driven by a variety of factors, such as the increasing use of weight management pharmaceutical products, increasing health and wellness awareness, greater transparency in product labeling, and changes in global, regional or local economic conditions (such as inflation, unemployment, salaries and wage rates stagnation, low growth rates, and impacts of supply disruptions, climate events, or geopolitical developments). At the same time, increased regulatory requirements, statements or questions around certain of our products, may result in changes in customer orders or delays in developing, manufacturing or marketing of new or existing products. Moreover, given that the timing or volumes in our customers’ orders are generally at our customers’ discretion, customers may cancel, reduce or postpone orders with us on relatively short notice. These and other consumer and regulatory trends may continue to affect the demand for our products and impact our ability to meet certain productivity levels. If we are unable to anticipate or react to these trends in a timely and cost-effective manner, our productivity, results of operations and future growth may be adversely affected. Our business is highly competitive, and if we are unable to compete effectively, our sales and results of operations will suffer. 11 Table of Contents We face intense global competition from multinational and specialized companies across our product offerings, as well as consumer product companies developing their own alternatives. Competitors may have greater resources, proprietary technologies, or benefit from recent industry consolidation, enabling them to respond more effectively to customer or market demands. As we expand into adjacent markets, such as functional foods and specialty fine ingredients, we encounter additional risks, including price sensitivity and lower margins. Our ability to compete depends on, among other things, innovation, product quality, regulatory compliance, pricing, logistical efficiency, digital proficiency, customer service, and intellectual property protection. Failure to invest in growth, scale new concepts, or adapt to technological advancements could erode our competitive position. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow covers dividends and buybacks combined, so shareholder returns are funded from internally generated cash rather than incremental borrowing. This supports the liquidity profile despite weak reported earnings, and the ratio improved versus the prior year, indicating modestly better cash conversion relative to debt.

The issuer retains a diversified ingredient portfolio across Taste, Food Ingredients, Health & Biosciences and Scent, with the Pharma Solutions divestiture completed and proceeds applied to tender offers. Deleveraging progress is visible, with total debt reduced materially year over year, which partly offsets the still elevated leverage position.

key_risks.text: Leverage is the central weakness: gross leverage sits far above the sector median and roughly doubled versus the prior year, placing the issuer in the weakest indicative risk tier. Coverage is negative on an operating-income basis, so earnings do not currently service interest, and the gap to the upgrade threshold remains wide.

Demand risk is concrete: consumer preference shifts, including weight-management pharmaceuticals, plus regulatory scrutiny and short-notice customer cancellations could pressure volumes and productivity. Intense competition and price sensitivity in adjacent categories add margin pressure, which matters given the already negative operating margin and thin free cash flow relative to debt.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Free cash flow falls short of dividends, so distributions absorb more than internally generated free cash after capital spending. Debt reduction therefore depends on divestiture proceeds and refinancing rather than retained cash flow, and free cash flow to debt trails the sector median, limiting organic deleveraging capacity.

The maturity profile concentrates near-term: a large tranche of notes and short-term borrowings fall due within the next twelve months, alongside commercial paper usage. Refinancing risk is meaningful given the negative coverage, though the revolving facility and prior tender offers show continued market access at reasonable cost.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is highly leveraged, driven by weak leverage and cash-flow tiers, with leverage far above the sector median and coverage well below peers. Liquidity is adequate on a current-ratio basis but below both the prior year and the sector median, so the cushion is thinner than typical for the sector.

Our forward view is that credit quality hinges on completing asset sales and applying proceeds to debt, plus restoring positive operating income. Absent that, negative coverage and free cash flow below distributions leave little headroom, and the issuer would remain reliant on refinancing the near-term maturities at acceptable spreads.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流足以覆蓋股息與回購之總和，因此股東回報乃由內部產生之現金而非新增借貸所支持。儘管報告盈利疲弱，此舉仍支撐流動性狀況，且該比率較上年有所改善，顯示現金轉換相對債務而言略有改善。
發行人仍維持涵蓋味覺、食品配料、健康與生物科學及香氛之多元化配料組合，且製藥解決方案之剝離已完成，所得款項已用於要約收購。去槓桿進展可見，總債務較上年大幅減少，部分抵銷了仍然高企的槓桿狀況。

key_risks.text: 槓桿為核心弱點：總槓桿遠高於行業中位數，且較上年大致翻倍，使發行人處於最弱的指示性風險層級。以營業利潤為基礎之覆蓋率為負，故盈利目前不足以支付利息，且與升級門檻之差距仍然廣闊。
需求風險具體存在：消費者偏好轉變，包括體重管理藥物，加上監管審查及客戶短時間通知取消，可能對銷量及生產力構成壓力。鄰近類別之激烈競爭及價格敏感度增添利潤率壓力，鑑於營業利潤率已為負且自由現金流相對債務而言偏薄，此點尤為重要。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 自由現金流不足以覆蓋股息，故分派所吸收者超過資本開支後內部產生之自由現金。因此，債務削減依賴剝離所得款項及再融資而非留存現金流，且自由現金流對債務之比率落後於行業中位數，限制了內生去槓桿能力。
到期結構集中於近期：一大批次票據及短期借款將於未來十二個月內到期，同時另有商業票據之使用。鑑於覆蓋率為負，再融資風險意義重大，儘管循環融資額度及先前之要約收購顯示其仍能以合理成本持續進入市場。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為高度槓桿，受疲弱之槓桿及現金流層級所驅動，槓桿遠高於行業中位數且覆蓋率遠低於同業。以流動比率而言流動性尚可，但低於上年及行業中位數，故緩衝較行業典型水平為薄。
我們的前瞻觀點是，信貸質量取決於完成資產出售並將所得款項用於債務，以及恢復正營業利潤。若缺乏此等條件，負覆蓋率及低於分派之自由現金流將留下甚少餘裕，發行人將繼續依賴以可接受息差再融資近期到期債務。
